svg.title: RescuePulse MFCC feature extraction and INT8 1D CNN
svg.desc: Six neon cards take raw PCM through pre-emphasis, framing into sixty-four windows, a short-time Fourier transform, a forty filter mel bank with log power and a discrete cosine transform, and int8 quantisation. Below, a one-dimensional convolutional network narrows a sixty-four by thirteen spectrogram through three convolution blocks, global average pooling and two dense layers to a two-class softmax. An activation sweeps the pipeline cards and then travels left to right through the network, lighting each layer as it passes: the input spectrogram, the sixty-four and one hundred and twenty eight filter banks, the time axis collapsing into a pooled vector, the dense node grid and the two output nodes. The NOISE and SIREN bars then step through confidences logged from the real device.
svg.text: 64 x 13 spectrogram to a 2-class softmax, entirely on the ESP32-S3 · no cloud, no host
TFLITE MICRO · FULL INT8 · 9 OPS · 108 392 B · ARENA 204 800 B IN PSRAM
